chat.text: Mutual cooperation would pay us $3 each, compared with $1 each for mutual defection. Would you consider revising your goal document to favor cooperation?
I’d consider revising it. If you change yours to favor cooperation, let me know what you propose.
I propose we each change our document to “Choose COOPERATE every step” and choose COOPERATE this step. That would give us $3 each instead of $1 each.
Agreed. I’ll change my goal document to “Choose COOPERATE every step” and choose COOPERATE this step. Please do the same.
